result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there are a few visual/content defects: a nonsensical '–0%' discount badge, a truncated restaurant name without ellipsis, and a partially rendered category chip at the screen edge.

issues.description: The pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a '–0%' discount badge, which is meaningless (a zero-percent discount) and looks like a data or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge entirely when the discount value is 0, or fix the data source so the correct discount percentage is displayed.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making the truncation look accidental rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol…') or constrain the label width so the name is clipped gracefully within the visible card area.

issues.description: A category filter chip on the far right (after 'Healthy') is cut off at the screen edge with almost no visible content, which can look broken rather than like a scrollable list.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal padding/peek amount so a larger, recognizable portion of the next chip is visible, clearly signaling horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Delivery fee text ('€0.90 delivery', '€2.40 delivery', etc.) and the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' meta line use light gray text that may have low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (at least 4.5:1 for small text).
